svg.title: Patchy contest — 010 / Before the boundary is named — 27 June responders
svg.desc: Fog of war, Patchy contest: 010 / Before the boundary is named, 27 June responders. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 dark. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response lit, correction dark, configuration dark, weights dark, staging dark. P6 is only an unnamed dark hint. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Shaded relief with a soft, irregular fog edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Many pictograms lie draped on the ground beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: ONE FORM OF EACH FAMILY SHOWN / ALL LIE UNDER THE FOG
THE ALERT, BOARD AND PIVOT DO NOT DISCLOSE THE WHOLE EVENT.
010.3–4 / disputed scorer accounts; design / fixed response boundary · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC RELIEF / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
